title: Sweep Neural Engine Scientific Benchmark — CORRECTED
scoring_correction: Fixed _map_decision_to_answer bug that was returning expected答案 instead of mapping model output
honest_assessment: Sweep is a rule-based evidence evaluator, NOT a general-purpose LLM. Previous 99.3% score was inflated by a scoring bug. Corrected accuracy: 10.2%.

Sweep.note: Cannot be compared — different system type

key_findings: The neural engine's contribution is NOT measurably demonstrated
Sweep has 18-30x lower latency than API-based LLMs
Sweep's calibration is extremely poor (overconfident on wrong answers)
